generator.program.note: The program the authors chose to grow this taxon's shrub species (named in each species' spec until G2.3a moved it here).

traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 1926), families 48 Caprifoliaceae, 312 Valerianaceae and 313 Dipsacaceae, which APG joins as Caprifoliaceae (Sambucus and Viburnum go to Viburnaceae): leaves opposite, simple or deeply divided; flowers mostly in cymes, in heads in the teasels. The order's file states the opposite leaves, the missing stipules and the inferior ovary.
